scripts.build: pnpm --filter @money-tracker/design-system build && pnpm --filter @money-tracker/design-system-showcase build && pnpm --filter @money-tracker/desktop build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm codegen && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json playwright.config.ts libs/web-design-system apps/design-system-showcase tests/design-system apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/package.json apps/desktop/tsconfig.json apps/desktop/vite.config.ts apps/desktop/index.html apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities tests/desktop playwright.desktop.config.ts scripts/desktop-fixture.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json playwright.config.ts libs/web-design-system apps/design-system-showcase tests/design-system apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/package.json apps/desktop/tsconfig.json apps/desktop/vite.config.ts apps/desktop/index.html apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities tests/desktop playwright.desktop.config.ts scripts/desktop-fixture.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: pnpm build && node scripts/desktop-fixture.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.desktop.config.ts
